about.en:
Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları) is the Turkish government's fully funded programme for international students, run by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB). The Graduate Scholarship Programme places winners in master's and PhD programmes in social sciences, humanities, natural sciences and engineering at leading Turkish universities; YTB handles university placement as part of the award.

The scholarship covers full tuition, a monthly stipend (TRY 9,500 for master's, TRY 13,000 for PhD at the time of checking), university dormitory accommodation, health insurance, a one-off return flight and a one-year Turkish language course before the degree. Most programmes are taught in Turkish, so the language year is part of the package.

Applications are made online in the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) between 10 January and 20 February every year. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed (in person or online) in spring and results come out in summer for an autumn start.

en: Tuition, stipend, dorm, insurance and flights all covered
One-year Turkish language course included
Open to citizens of every country, including Georgia and Qatar

eligibility.en: Citizens of any country (not Turkish citizens or those who lost Turkish citizenship). Master's applicants must be under 30 and PhD applicants under 35 on the application date. Minimum academic achievement for graduate candidates: 75% (or equivalent). Graduates or final-year students who will graduate before August may apply. Georgian and Qatari citizens are eligible.

en: Search eligible universities and programmes on turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Create an account in the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) and fill in the form between 10 January and 20 February
Upload transcript, diploma, passport/ID, photo, statement of purpose, research proposal (PhD) and language scores if available
Choose up to the allowed number of universities and programmes
Attend the interview if shortlisted; results are announced in summer

costs.en: Fully funded: tuition, monthly stipend (master's TRY 9,500; PhD TRY 13,000; Merit track pays double), accommodation, health insurance, one-off flight ticket at the start and end, and a 1-year Turkish course. No application fee.

score_reason: Fully funded, open to every nationality, window opens in 10 weeks

about.en:
The Merit Scholarship Program is a special track within Türkiye Scholarships for international students with outstanding academic records. Winners receive the standard Türkiye Scholarships package (tuition, accommodation, health insurance, flights, Turkish course) but with a monthly stipend twice the regular amount.

Eligibility is judged on a high general weighted average plus high scores in international language proficiency and academic qualification exams set by the Presidency (for example IELTS 7.0 for graduate levels, with GRE/GMAT-type results counted). It is aimed at students who would be competitive for top scholarships anywhere.

You apply through the same TBBS system in the 10 January–20 February window and indicate your merit eligibility with test scores; selection includes an interview.

en: Monthly stipend twice the standard Türkiye Scholarships rate
Full tuition, dorm, insurance and flights
Rewards strong IELTS/TOEFL and GRE/GMAT scores

eligibility.en: International students of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) with a very high GPA and the language/academic test scores listed on the official criteria page (e.g. IELTS 7.0). Master's under 30, PhD under 35.

en: Check the Merit criteria for your level on turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Take the required language and academic tests before February
Apply in TBBS between 10 January and 20 February with all scores uploaded
Attend the interview if shortlisted

costs.en: Fully funded with a double monthly stipend (regular rates: master's TRY 9,500, PhD TRY 13,000), plus tuition, accommodation, health insurance, flights and Turkish course.

score_reason: Very generous but demands top grades and test scores

The Türkiye Scholarships Arts Programme funds international students in performing arts, music and fine arts at three partner universities: Ankara Music and Fine Arts University, Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli University and Istanbul Technical University (home of the renowned MIAM music centre). Graduate options include master's degrees in instrument education, music technologies, music theory, musicology, voice and composition, and a PhD in music sciences.

Winners get the full Türkiye Scholarships package: tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, flights and a one-year Turkish course. Selection weighs your portfolio or performance recordings alongside academics, and shortlisted candidates may be asked for an audition or interview.

Apply in TBBS in the standard 10 January–20 February window and choose the Arts Scholarship Program.

eligibility.en: International applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) with a relevant bachelor's (for master's) or master's (for PhD); master's under 30, PhD under 35; minimum 75% academic achievement.

about.en:
Stipendium Hungaricum is the Hungarian government's flagship scholarship, managed by Tempus Public Foundation and based on bilateral agreements with around 90 partner countries. It funds full master's and doctoral degrees (as well as bachelor's) at Hungarian universities such as ELTE, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Corvinus, Debrecen, Szeged and Pécs, with hundreds of English-taught programmes.

The award includes tuition-free education, a monthly stipend, an accommodation contribution (or a dormitory place) and medical insurance. PhD holders receive a considerably higher stipend than master's students. Applicants are first nominated by their home country's Sending Partner (usually the ministry of education) and then admitted by the Hungarian university.

The call for 2027/28 is expected in November 2026, with an online deadline around 15 January 2027 and studies starting in September 2027.

en: Tuition-free study plus stipend, housing support and insurance
Hundreds of English-taught master's and PhD programmes
Georgia is among the partner countries

eligibility.en: Citizens of Stipendium Hungaricum partner countries (Georgia is a partner; check the current list for your country, including Qatar) who are nominated by their Sending Partner and meet the university's admission requirements. Hungarian citizens and dual nationals are excluded.

en: Check your country's quota and rules with your Sending Partner (in Georgia: the Ministry of Education)
Choose up to two programmes on the Stipendium Hungaricum programme finder
Submit the online application with transcripts, language certificate, motivation letter and medical certificate before the January deadline
Apply to your Sending Partner as well if it runs its own procedure
Take the university's entrance exam/interview in spring; results in early summer

costs.en: Tuition waived; monthly stipend (higher for PhD), monthly accommodation contribution or dorm place, medical insurance. No application fee.

about.en:
The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES) are run by the Higher Education Authority to attract top international students to Irish higher education. Each year 60 scholars receive a €10,000 stipend and a full tuition-fee waiver from their host institution for one year of full-time study at master's/postgraduate diploma (NFQ level 9) or PhD (level 10) level.

Eligible hosts include the Irish universities and technological universities (Trinity, UCD, University of Galway, UCC, DCU, Maynooth, UL and others). For a one-year taught master's, the award effectively covers the whole degree; PhD students receive it for one year of their programme. Scholars also act as ambassadors for Irish education.

You need an offer (conditional or final) from an eligible Irish institution when you apply. The call normally opens in winter and closes in mid-March, with results in early June.

en: €10,000 stipend plus full fee waiver
Covers a whole one-year master's
60 awards across all subjects

eligibility.en: Applicants whose domicile of origin is outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK (Georgian and Qatari students qualify), with an offer from an eligible Irish HEI for a level 9 or 10 programme. Russian and Belarusian nationals and previous GOI-IES holders are not eligible.

en: Apply to a master's or PhD at an eligible Irish university and obtain an offer
Watch hea.ie for the 2027 call document
Submit the online application with CV, personal statement, academic transcripts and two references before the deadline
Results are announced in early June

costs.en: €10,000 stipend for one year plus a full tuition-fee waiver from the host institution for that year.

about.en:
The Education Exchanges Support Foundation, on behalf of Lithuania's Ministry of Education, Science and Sport, offers state scholarships for full-time master's degrees (or the last two years of integrated studies) at Lithuanian higher education institutions such as Vilnius University, Kaunas University of Technology, Vytautas Magnus University and VILNIUS TECH.

There is no form and no deadline: if you receive an offer and meet the grade thresholds, the reduction is added to your offer. Reading also hosts GREAT, Commonwealth and departmental scholarships that may be applied for separately.

about.en:
GREAT Scholarships are jointly funded by the UK government's GREAT Britain Campaign, the British Council and participating UK universities. Each award is worth at least £10,000 towards tuition for a one-year taught master's, and dozens of universities each offer awards to students from specific countries (recent lists have included Bangladesh, Ghana, India, Kenya, Pakistan, Egypt, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Thailand, Türkiye, Vietnam and others).

You apply to the university, not the British Council, after receiving an offer. For 2027-28, for example, the University of Reading's GREAT awards for Bangladesh and Ghana close on 3 May 2027. Check the British Council Study UK site for the full 2027 country/university list as it is published.

about.en:
The Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship combines UM's own Scholarship Fund with the Dutch government's NL Scholarship to give 18 full awards per year to highly talented non-EU/EEA students admitted to a participating UM master's.

For 2027-28 the package covers tuition, visa costs, pre-academic training and health/liability insurance, plus a living allowance of €20,150 for a one-year master's (13 months) or €38,750 for a two-year master's (25 months). Flights are not covered. You need a GPA of at least 7.5/10 (75% or 3.0/4.0).

Apply to the master's through Studielink with a complete file by 10 December 2026, then submit the scholarship form (CV, motivation letter, transcript, financial-need statement, reference letter) between 1 October 2026 and 1 February 2027. Only one submission is allowed.

about.en:
The Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) Bilateral Program, known as Type A, is the government-to-government route of China's flagship scholarship. Quotas are agreed with each partner country, and candidates are nominated by their home ministry of education or the Chinese embassy before being placed at a Chinese university.

It is a full scholarship: tuition waived, free campus accommodation or a housing subsidy, a monthly stipend (CNY 3,000 master's, CNY 3,500 PhD) and comprehensive medical insurance. Master's applicants must hold a bachelor's and be under 35; PhD applicants need a master's and must be under 40. Many programmes are taught in Chinese (with a preparatory language year), but English-taught options exist.

Applications are filed on the CSC Study in China portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) and submitted to your dispatching authority, typically between early January and early March.

en: Full scholarship with monthly stipend
Hundreds of Chinese universities
Government nomination route — less crowded than university route in some countries

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; bachelor's holders under 35 for master's, master's holders under 40 for PhD; nominated by the dispatching authority of a country with a CSC agreement (Georgia has a quota via its Ministry of Education/Chinese Embassy; check for Qatar).

en: Contact your Ministry of Education or the Chinese embassy for the 2027 Type A call
Choose up to three Chinese universities/programmes
Fill in the online form on studyinchina.csc.edu.cn with the agency number given by your dispatching authority
Submit printed documents (notarised degrees, transcripts, study plan, two references, physical exam form) to the dispatching authority
Await CSC placement results (usually summer)

costs.en: Tuition waived, free campus accommodation (or subsidy), monthly stipend CNY 3,000 (master's) / CNY 3,500 (PhD), comprehensive medical insurance (CNY 800/year).

score_reason: Fully funded and widely available; deadline set per country

about.en:

Scholarships run for three years (master's) or four years (PhD).

Winners are exempt from tuition and receive free on-campus accommodation, a monthly allowance of CNY 3,000 (master's) or CNY 3,500 (PhD) and CSC comprehensive medical insurance. Master's applicants must be under 35 with a bachelor's; PhD applicants under 40 with a master's. Most programmes are in Chinese, some in English.

Apply between 1 November 2026 and 15 February 2027 on the CSC portal (Agency No. 10141) and DUT's own system.

Strong engineering and chemistry programmes
Silk Road track for Belt and Road countries

It is UBC's main tool for attracting outstanding domestic and international PhD students with stable base funding, and graduate programs often top it up with research or teaching assistantships.

There is no direct application: each UBC graduate program nominates its strongest incoming and continuing doctoral students and sets its own internal deadline. Apply to your PhD program by its admission deadline (often December–January) to be considered.

about.en:
The Taiwan Scholarship, funded by Taiwan's Ministry of Education (MOE), supports international students on full degree programmes at Taiwanese universities such as National Taiwan University, National Tsing Hua, National Cheng Kung and National Yang Ming Chiao Tung. Graduate awards last up to two years for a master's and four years for a PhD.

The scholarship pays tuition and miscellaneous fees up to a set cap per semester and a monthly living stipend, with a higher stipend for graduate students than undergraduates. Applicants must apply separately for admission to their chosen Taiwanese university; many programmes are taught in English.

Applications are submitted to the Taiwan embassy or Taipei representative office responsible for your country, generally between February and April (the 2026 guidelines set 31 March as the postmark deadline). Check your local office's 2027 announcement for exact dates and documents.

about.en:
The PolyU Presidential PhD Fellowship Scheme (PPPFS) is The Hong Kong Polytechnic University's own elite fellowship for outstanding PhD candidates, run alongside the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS). For the whole normal study period, fellows receive an annual stipend of HK$340,800, a conference grant of HK$25,000, a Research Excellence Scholarship as a full tuition fee waiver, a cash award (HK$40,000 in year one, HK$20,000 a year afterwards) and an eligible hall place for one year.

Selection is very competitive: applicants must meet PolyU's PhD entry and English requirements and show exceptional academic achievement, quality international publications, outstanding references and leadership. Anyone applying to PolyU through HKPFS is automatically considered for PPPFS, the Kuok Group Fellowship and the International PhD Fellowship Scheme.

Conference grant and cash award
Automatic consideration via HKPFS application

eligibility.en: Applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) to PolyU PhD programmes who apply through the HKPFS and show exceptional research potential.

Upload research proposal, publications, CV and references
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed; PPPFS is considered automatically

Lancaster University's Master's Excellence Scholarship rewards students who achieve a 2:1 or first-class undergraduate degree (or equivalent) with a 15% tuition fee reduction worth up to £4,635. It applies to taught master's programmes starting in 2027 and is the main merit award for international students from countries not covered by Lancaster's regional scholarships, including Georgia and Qatar.

You are considered automatically when you apply. Lancaster also offers a £2,000 early-acceptance scholarship to international students who accept their place before 7 April 2027.

about.en:
The Ernst Mach Grant Worldwide, administered by OeAD on behalf of Austria's Federal Ministry of Women, Science and Research, supports young researchers and university lecturers of all disciplines who are studying or researching outside Austria and want to carry out a research project in Austria. The target group is postgraduates (typically doctoral candidates) and postdocs from all countries.

Grants last one to nine months and are hosted by an Austrian university or research institution, which you must arrange yourself (an invitation/supervision confirmation is part of the application). The grant includes a monthly payment and OeAD support with insurance and housing; check grants.at for current rates. The annual closing date is 1 December for stays in the following academic year.

en: Open to all nationalities
1–9 month research stays, any discipline
Austrian host supervisor of your choice

eligibility.en: Doctoral candidates/postgraduates and postdocs of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) studying or researching outside Austria, with a confirmed Austrian host.

en: Agree a project and obtain a host confirmation from an Austrian university or institute
Prepare research plan, CV, degree certificates and recommendation letter(s)
Apply online via grants.at (OeAD) by 1 December 2026
Results in spring; stay during the 2027-28 academic year

costs.en: Monthly grant from OeAD plus support with insurance and accommodation (rates on grants.at).

about.en:
This Ernst Mach Grant lets undergraduate and graduate students from non-European countries study for four to ten months at an Austrian university of applied sciences (Fachhochschule), such as FH Technikum Wien, FH Joanneum or FH Campus Wien. It is a funded study period rather than a full degree, useful for master's students who want a semester of applied, industry-linked study in Austria.

OeAD pays a monthly grant and helps with insurance and housing. You need a nomination or acceptance from the Austrian FH, which usually works with partner universities; apply on grants.at by 1 February.

en: Funded semester or year in Austria
Applied, industry-linked programmes
For students from outside Europe

eligibility.en: Undergraduate or graduate students from non-European countries (e.g. Qatar and other Middle Eastern, Asian, African and American countries; check with OeAD whether Georgia counts as European) with acceptance by an Austrian FH.

about.en:
The Scholarship Foundation of the Republic of Austria funds master's study in the field of International Relations in Austria (for example at the Diplomatic Academy of Vienna or Austrian universities). The scholarships are intended for descendants of forced labourers under the National Socialist regime and for nationals of countries that suffered particularly from that regime, which includes many Central and Eastern European and former Soviet states.

Awards cover nine months and are administered by OeAD. The annual closing date is 1 April.

Targets Central/Eastern Europe and post-Soviet countries
Administered by OeAD

about.en:
The LiU International Scholarship supports international master's students with significant academic potential who must pay tuition fees at Linköping University, known for engineering, computer science, medicine and interdisciplinary programmes. Holders normally have their tuition reduced by 50%.

To be eligible you must apply in the first admission round on universityadmissions.se (deadline 15 January 2027), submit all documents on time, rank a LiU programme first and be admitted in the first selection results (end of March). LiU also requires a GPA of at least 3.5/4.0 or equivalent. The scholarship application window opens in early April 2027 and is short; no extra documents are needed.

Seoul National University's Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) supports non-Korean applicants who studied in or graduated from eligible countries and are admitted to SNU graduate programmes. It provides full tuition exemption for up to four semesters and living expenses of at least KRW 500,000 per month (varies by major).

There is no separate form: tick 'Application for Scholarship' in the online SNU graduate admission application, and colleges select recipients from the admission documents. The list of eligible countries and participating colleges changes every semester and is published in the Office of Global Affairs guide.

Monthly living support from KRW 500,000

summary.en: A full PhD scholarship at Seoul National University for university lecturers from developing countries who do not yet hold a PhD: tuition, KRW 1.5–2 million a month for 3–4 years, airfare and Korean classes.
summary.ka: სრული სადოქტორო სტიპენდია სეულის ეროვნულ უნივერსიტეტში განვითარებადი ქვეყნების ლექტორებისთვის, რომლებსაც ჯერ არ აქვთ PhD: სწავლა, თვეში KRW 1.5–2 მილიონი 3–4 წლის განმავლობაში, ავიაბილეთი და კორეული ენის კურსი.

about.en:
The SNU President Fellowship (SPF) brings faculty members of major universities in developing countries to Seoul National University for a PhD. About eight recipients are chosen each semester, with priority for candidates from Asia, Africa and South America.

It covers full tuition for up to six semesters, living expenses of KRW 1,500,000–2,000,000 per month for three to four years, a round-trip economy airfare and evening Korean classes. Apply by ticking the scholarship box in the SNU graduate admission application and submitting evidence documents to the Office of Global Affairs.

en: Living allowance KRW 1.5–2 million/month
Tuition up to 6 semesters + airfare
Aimed at future professors from developing countries

eligibility.en: Faculty members of major universities in developing countries without a PhD, newly admitted to an SNU PhD programme (Georgia qualifies as a developing country on most lists; check with SNU).

en: Apply for an SNU PhD programme in the Fall 2027 round
Tick 'Application for Scholarship' and select SPF
Submit proof of your faculty appointment to SNU Office of Global Affairs
Selection announced with admission

costs.en: Full tuition (6 semesters), KRW 1.5–2M monthly living allowance, round-trip airfare, Korean language classes.

score_reason: Generous but only for university faculty

summary.ka: კაიროს ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტი სტიპენდიებს სთავაზობს საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს, რომლებიც მის სამაგისტრო პროგრამებზე ჩაირიცხნენ: სწავლის საფასური და სრული განაკვეთის უცხოელებისთვის საცხოვრებლის დახმარება. 2027 შემოდგომის პირველი ციკლი 2026 წლის 22 დეკემბრიდან 2027 წლის 17 იანვრამდე.
summary.ar: تقدم الجامعة الأمريكية بالقاهرة زمالات تغطي الرسوم (مع بدل سكن للطلاب الدوليين بدوام كامل) للطلاب الدوليين المقبولين في برامج الدراسات العليا. الدورة الأولى لخريف 2027 من 22 ديسمبر 2026 إلى 17 يناير 2027.

about.en:
The American University in Cairo, Egypt's leading English-language university, runs institutional fellowships for graduate students. The International Graduate Fellowship is open to international students fully admitted to any field of graduate study; other fellowships target African students, refugees, and all nationalities in selected HUSS, business, public affairs (GAPP) and education programmes. International fellowship holders who study full time may also receive a housing allowance.

For Fall 2027 there are two cycles: 22 December 2026–17 January 2027 and 6 April–6 May 2027. Submit your graduate admission application at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline; you do not need an admission decision first. MEng, Master in Computing and diploma students are not eligible.

en: Open to all nationalities
Housing allowance for full-time international fellows
Strong in Middle East studies, policy and IR

eligibility.en: International students (all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar) fully admitted to an AUC master's or PhD (excluding MEng, Master in Computing and diplomas).

en: Submit your AUC graduate admission application at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline
Complete the online fellowship application in cycle 1 (by 17 Jan 2027) or cycle 2 (by 6 May 2027)
Await the fellowship decision with or after admission

costs.en: Tuition coverage (full or partial per fellowship) plus possible housing allowance for full-time international students.

score_reason: Clear deadlines, open to all nationalities

summary.ka: Türkiye Scholarships-ის ჯილდო წარჩინებული უცხოელი სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებიც უკვე საკუთარი ხარჯით სწავლობენ თურქეთის უნივერსიტეტებში, მათ შორის მაგისტრანტებისა და დოქტორანტებისთვის. განაცხადი ღიაა 2026 წლის ოქტომბერ–ნოემბერში.
summary.ar: منحة من منح تركيا للطلاب الدوليين المتفوقين المسجلين بالفعل في الجامعات التركية على نفقتهم الخاصة، بمن فيهم طلاب الماجستير والدكتوراه. التقديم مفتوح في أكتوبر–نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Besides its main degree scholarships, Türkiye Scholarships runs a Success Scholarship for international students who are already studying in Türkiye without a government scholarship and who have strong academic results. It is a way to obtain Türkiye Scholarships support part-way through a bachelor's, master's or PhD.

Applications are taken each October–November through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS). Successful students receive Türkiye Scholarships benefits (such as the monthly stipend and health insurance) for the remaining period of their programme, as set out in the annual call.

en: For students already enrolled in Türkiye
Open now (October–November 2026)
Adds Türkiye Scholarships stipend and benefits

eligibility.en: International students (any nationality incl. Georgia and Qatar) currently enrolled at a Turkish university at their own expense with high academic achievement; not already holding a Turkish government scholarship.

en: Log in to TBBS (tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr)
Select the Success Scholarship call during October–November
Upload transcript, student certificate and passport
Await evaluation and results

costs.en: Türkiye Scholarships benefits for the remaining study period (stipend: master's TRY 9,500, PhD TRY 13,000 at current rates; insurance). Details in the annual call.

about.en:
CUHK offers Postgraduate Studentships to qualified full-time research postgraduate students (MPhil and PhD). The annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (about US$29,400), payable throughout the normative period of study, and results are announced together with admission offers.

Strong candidates may additionally receive the CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship, and nationals of Belt and Road countries can be nominated for the HKSAR government's tuition scholarship. Apply through CUHK's online application system by your programme's deadline.

en: HK$229,200 per year
Covers MPhil and PhD
Decided with admission

Studentship offered with admission if qualified

It is a small award but easy to obtain, and useful when combined with Lancaster's Master's Excellence (15%) or International Regional (£10,000) scholarships, subject to their terms.
